description: Assurance-module packs shipped with the platform (PROP-003). Third-party packs live in ~/.tda/assurance_modules/ and are discovered without an entry here. Nothing in this file binds anything: installing a pack makes its modules available, and an operator assigns them in Config → Trust → Assessment modules.

modules.notes: The reference implementation. Shipped DISABLED — it asserts a disclaimer rule no real deployment shares, and is here to be read and copied, not run.
